column1: # Source of truth: the Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3 repo pinned at the same revision the
# Nightfall Blackwell base image uses in /opt/minimax-h3/minimax_h3_download_setup.sh
# copied verbatim from that script's DOWNLOAD_SIZES / DOWNLOAD_SHA256 tables.
# REF2VA is now included: reference generation (images / videos / audio) is a separate
# checkpoint, not a mode of FL2VA, so the +21 GB is what reference modes cost.
# The Turbo LoRAs are pinned to a DIFFERENT revision on purpose. They did not exist at
# eb8a16107c59 - the loras/ directory was added later - and
# re-pinning the diffusion weights to pick them up would change the DiT bytes that every
# existing benchmark was measured against. Two revisions, each pinned, is the honest way
# to add new files without disturbing old measurements.
# There is no 8-step Ref2VA LoRA published at that revision; only 4-step, at v0.1.
